correctness.rationale: The reduction and exhaustive lower bound were independently replayed. There are exactly 139 nontrivial cyclic-subgroup types, represented by nonempty partial assignments in alphabets of sizes 3,4,6, and adjacency is inclusion comparability. The canonical ten nondistinguished prime-line generators plus one distinguished order-30 generator dominate. A fresh exact branch-and-bound replay reconstructed all comparability neighborhoods and exhausted 1,022,864 search nodes without any dominating family of size 10. The pruning lower bound uses maximum remaining coverage and is logically safe, so the finite computation is exhaustive rather than experimental.

value.rationale: Order 900 is the smallest nilpotent boundary where three distinct primes occur and every Sylow subgroup is noncyclic. Establishing equality at the general upper bound is therefore a natural first exact test beyond the published two-prime regime. The fact is finite but motivated and complete, not an arbitrary census point.
residual_risks: The result is one boundary case, not a classification of all three-prime nilpotent groups.
